recipe.visualDefinition: A full-length stylized portrait of a man in casual attire, set against a hazy, textured gradient background featuring floating ethereal figures and delicate handwritten script.
coreVisualRelationships: Central figure anchored vertically against a soft, non-representational horizon
Symmetrical placement of four small winged figures flanking the subject's head
Contrast between the tactile realism of the denim and the hazy, airbrushed skin and background
Diagonal tension created by off-center script elements
coreInvariants: Muted, desaturated color palette with a dominant mauve/pink undertone
Fine horizontal scan-line or canvas texture across the entire image

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Full-body central subject, occupying approximately 70% of the vertical height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the bright white t-shirt act as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the face, moves outward to the flanking winged figures, then down the vertical line of the body to the secondary script on the left.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample breathing room around the subject, filled with a hazy, atmospheric gradient.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Dusty rose and mauve background tones providing a warm, nostalgic atmosphere.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Cool cerulean blue of the denim pants providing a grounded contrast to the warm background.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright white of the t-shirt and script for high-value highlights.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high-key lighting on the subject's torso; values are compressed to create a dreamlike, low-contrast effect.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Cursive script with a slight upward slant
letterConstructionRules: Connected lowercase letters with long, flowing entry and exit strokes
Informal, handwritten appearance with varying baseline stability
characterSpecificRedesigns: Extremely elongated horizontal bars on 't' or 'f' characters
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single-style handwritten script used for both primary and secondary text to maintain a personal, diary-like feel.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the informal, personal tone of the original lettering.
Mimics the appearance of a personal mark or autograph.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a full-body portrait of a man in a white t-shirt and blue jeans, airbrushed style, soft focus, against a hazy mauve and pink gradient background with four small pink winged figures floating symmetrically near his head. Apply a fine horizontal line texture.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add white, thin, handwritten cursive script in the top right and middle left areas, ensuring a soft glow effect around the letters to blend with the hazy atmosphere.

verificationChecks: Is the lighting soft and diffused without harsh shadows?
Does the script look like natural handwriting rather than a rigid font?
Is the horizontal texture visible but subtle?
Are the winged figures integrated into the background haze?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the background pink/mauve hue
Density of the horizontal scan-line texture
Opacity of the floating winged figures
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
Any recognizable brand logos on clothing
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the subject's skin has a smooth, airbrushed quality.
Check that the script is legible but delicate.
Verify the symmetrical balance of the floating figures.
Confirm the overall image has a vintage 1980s print feel.
recipe.reuseFormula: Soft-focus airbrushed portrait + hazy mauve gradient + symmetrical ethereal icons + monolinear cursive script = Ethereal Americana aesthetic.
